scope: Observed public worker-table mapping and separately verified plot overview PRODUCTION / HR formula. Backend agreement and an account screen capture are separate checks. Missing inputs remain unknown. Plot reference labels are explanatory, not inferred screen labels.

workerFields.meaning: Worker base production before cap clipping; displayed only when powered.
Explicit reference label for retained base; not the Base Production table column.
Retained base plus terrain contribution, before additive production boosts.
Boostable production plus boost contributions; distinct from resource units per hour.
Resource output depends on worksite and efficiency; construction uses total_construction_pp instead.

capAllocation.rounding: Public preview rounds boostable production and each named boost contribution to three decimals before summing total production.

limits: This is client-source evidence, not a live backend formula verification.
Buildings with lower caps need their own effective cap.
Food discount composition and exact resource rounding require further evidence.

plotFields.formula: Positive runi_boost uses total_harvest_pp; otherwise an explicitly powered plot uses total_harvest_pp * efficiency, and an explicitly unpowered plot uses zero.
plotFields.units: Effective production points per hour, distinct from total_work_per_hour resource units.
plotFields.formatting: The server returns the unformatted numeric formula, without client locale rounding.
